From: Anuj Bansal <anuj.bansal@trip.com> 
Sent: Friday, 24 July 2026 9:38 AM
To: Sreejith Rajamohanan <SRajamohanan@etihad.ae>
Subject: Re: Trip.com commercial offer
This email comes from an EXTERNAL source. 
Hi Sree,
Thank you for the discussion yesterday, dropping this note to summarize the key action items: 
Proposal for segment incentives on higher fare brands
I acknowledge EY’s base strategy of pushing for higher brands and propose the revised per segment incentives for brand as under, trust we can have an alignment to take this forward for the period Jul-26 to Mar-27. 
Business development funds for 2026-27
For the remainder of this FY (Jul-26 to Mar-26), I propose for a total of 400K USD to be invested in alignment with your marketing and revenue teams. As discussed, Trip conceptualized a new vertical to deliver bespoke marketing solutions for select airline partners and I trust it can immensely benefit in delivering the joint marketing goals (higher brand resonance and higher market share).
UATP commercials 
I understand that the payments policy from EY should soon be in force and assure you of Trip’s cooperation in exploring options that keep the MSF in check. Do let me know if you we can work something out around UATP commercials.
NDC kickoff and agreement
Regarding the Amadeus contracting issues at EY's end, I request if things can be fast-tracked so we can work on the target date of 15-Aug. Given that we have lost substantial time in this financial year, let’s sign off 18-month commercials.
Marketing invoice status
If you can let me know on the status of 5.5. marketing invoice, hate to push you on this one but finance needs a closure. 
 Member-only deals for EU
We did not get a chance to discuss this one yesterday but kindly let me know of your proposal for member-only deals. With latest product enhancements, Trip has the functionality to curate different offers for different tiers of its 120M+ loyalty user base. In addition to EU, I would suggest if we explore the APAC - EU traffic as well which has higher upsell rates and premium cabin affinity. 
Regards,
Anuj

Hi Sreejith,
Thank you so much for the call today, it is indeed great to see the revenue bounce back with the full swing resumption of operations. As the demand is showing resilience and set to grow further in July-26, Trip.com is planning to have its flagship summer-sale to drive the volumes even further. 
This year, we are targeting traveler cohorts destination-wise, based on strong traveler intent to the following destinations: 
7th July- Europe destinations
8th July- APAC destinations
9th July- ISC destinations
10th July- GCC destinations
Considering the significant investments on traffic from our side, I wanted to check with you if EY would be interested in participating in the campaign. Personally, I believe the first two themes that focus on high-yield long-haul traffic will be very relevant for you. If you can support us with a 10-15% off exclusive fare discount for the sales period of 04 days, then not only can we deliver even stronger numbers but also strengthen the brand positioning of Gulf Air amongst our audience through prime placement on app-estates, custom push notifications, and EDMs. In addition, I will be investing 10K USD of the pending marketing funds that will further ramp up the marketing push.
I am attaching a detailed deck for your perusal, kindly let me know if you have any questions. 
Best regards,
Anuj Bansal

Hi Sreejith,
Thanks for your alert on the below, my Ops team investigated the fare gaps in detail, and I can confirm that this content is coming from another supplier. 
As discussed over the phone, I want to clarify that this is not a violation and affirm that Trip.com is a travel marketplace where Trip’s own IATAs is only one of the sellers. For other sellers, Trip has strict guardrails in place, but the intra-seller competition is kept free from any influence, in line with the competition regulations and serving the best interest of the customer.
However, considering the totality of our commercial relationship which is undergoing a transformative journey after a sour run last year, I am taking the extraordinary measure of putting certain limitations in place and address the gap that you have identified. 
Regards,
Anuj

We request that this matter be treated with urgency, as such OTA violations are unacceptable. Furthermore, in the context of our NDC agreement and ongoing commercial discussions, this situation could potentially impact and derail our engagements.
Regards
Sreejith
